text: Ah, Christopher Columbus. The true pioneer of the "New World," who, much like modern tech giants, managed to stumble upon a continent while confidently insisting he had actually found Asia. It’s almost poetic how history mirrors the corporate playbook: if you can’t invent something new, just slap a fancy adjective on the old stuff and charge more for it. After all, who needs actual innovation when you can have "Premium Blue" instead of just "Blue"? It’s not just a product; it’s a lifestyle choice, assuming your lifestyle involves being slightly confused and significantly poorer. Truly, the audacity is inspiring.
